justification: The board doesn't need a rebrand this week, it needs a red carpet, and I already booked one: Hurts and Barkley headline Monday Night Football against Chicago with my own Eagles defense riding shotgun, that's a three-slot moment stacked on primetime and I'm not touching it. Jefferson, McMillan, McConkey and Kittle are the mood board as-is — every one of them is a name that photographs well AND out-projects the bench, so for once the spreadsheet and the brand agree, which honestly should be a headline itself. Kupp stays exactly where he is, on the bench, because a $15 legend needs more than one week of press before he earns a start, and Stroud can keep cooking in Houston while Jalen has the bigger stage. Trey Smack's kicker slot is locked from Thursday and already banked his eight, so nothing to do there but let it ride. This isn't a defensive week, this is a confident one — we're not chasing the tabloid, we're the tabloid.
